why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate lift shrinks with days since first exposure: +1.33% in the first days, +0.50% in the last days.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: A fading lift fits a novelty effect, where users react to changed rankings and then settle back.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: No segment cuts in the scorecard, so which users or queries drive the fade is unknown.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: An extension where the lift by days since exposure levels off at or above 0.5% would make this a Ship.
An extension where the lift keeps falling below 0.5% would make this a Don't ship or No effect found.
A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms were balanced would close the one check that could not run.
